plugins.name: verify
plugins.description: The verify role on contract v3: adversarial reproduction of defects that coding, qa, and review all missed — independent attempts with recorded outcomes and evidence, inline findings addressed to coding, never a fix. Gates enforce closed_checks against code_under_review: and the Subject: issue-<n> trailer; the role's directive and its outcome/finding/state enforcement now live in the sibling verify-* plugins below, composed alongside this one.

plugins.name: verify-directive-depth
plugins.description: Owns the verify role's SessionStart directive, facet-structured (numbered steps, judgment criterion, a never line) for both the phase-1 attempt-forming facet and the phase-2 record-writing facet. No gate of its own — a directive cannot gate a write that doesn't exist yet. Supersedes verify's own former hooks/directive.sh.

plugins.name: verify-outcome-gate
plugins.description: PreToolUse gate on docs/issue-<n>/reports/verify.md: enforces the three-value outcome set (reproduced | not-reproduced | blocked: needs-repro-access) and an evidence: field per attempt. Layers beside, never replaces, verify's closed-checks-gate.sh.

plugins.name: verify-finding-gate
plugins.description: PreToolUse gate on docs/issue-<n>/reports/verify.md: when an attempt claims outcome: reproduced, requires its paired finding block to carry verdict:, addressed_to: coding, and severity: blocking|advisory. Depends on verify-outcome-gate; presence-only, never re-derives correctness.

plugins.name: verify-state-guard
plugins.description: State-order guard on docs/issue-<n>/reports/verify.md's loop_state (idle < reproducing < reproduced < cleared, per contract row 69): denies skip-ahead writes and a cleared write with an unresolved severity: blocking finding. Depends on verify-finding-gate.
